# Trading Economics

> > Global economic data platform providing real-time quotes, historical data, and forecasts for government bonds, currencies, commodities, and stock markets across 196+ countries.

Trading Economics delivers comprehensive financial market data including bond yields (10-year, 52-week bills), forex rates (USD, EUR, GBP, JPY, and 20+ currencies), commodity prices, and equity indices. The platform serves investors, analysts, and researchers with charts, forecasts, and historical tracking for fixed income securities, currency exchange rates, and economic indicators.

## Key Topics

- Government bonds and bond yields
- Fixed income securities (bills, notes, treasuries)
- Currency exchange rates and forex data
- Commodity prices and trading
- Stock market indices
- 10-year bond benchmarks
- Treasury bill yields (52-week, 6-month, 3-month)
- Major currencies: USD, EUR, GBP, JPY, CHF, CAD, AUD
- Emerging market currencies: CNY, INR, BRL, RUB, MXN, KRW
- Historical data and price charts
- Market forecasts and economic indicators
- Electricity and energy prices
- CFD trading data

## Government Bonds & Fixed Income

- [United States 52 Week Bill Yield](https://tradingeconomics.com/united-states/52-week-bill-yield): US 52-week Treasury bill yield with historical data & forecasts
- [United Kingdom 52 Week Bill Yield](https://tradingeconomics.com/united-kingdom/52-week-bill-yield): UK 52-week Treasury bill yield with historical data & interest rates
- [Mexico 10-Year Government Bond Yield](https://tradingeconomics.com/mexico/government-bond-yield): Mexico 10Y bond yield data with quotes, charts & historical tracking
- [Canada 10-Year Government Bond Yield](https://tradingeconomics.com/canada/government-bond-yield): Canada 10Y bond yield with Bank of Canada monetary policy data
- [Chile 10-Year Government Bond Yield](https://tradingeconomics.com/chile/government-bond-yield): Chile 10Y government bond yield with fixed income market tracking
- [India 7 Year Note Yield](https://tradingeconomics.com/india/7-year-note-yield): India 7Y government bond yield tracking with forecasts & history
- [Italy 3 Month Bill Yield](https://tradingeconomics.com/italy/3-month-bill-yield): Italy 3-month government bond yield with historical charts & data
- [Portugal 6 Month Bill Yield](https://tradingeconomics.com/portugal/6-month-bill-yield): Portugal 6-month bill yield with interbank quotes & historical data
- [Spain 50 Year Bond Yield](https://tradingeconomics.com/spain/50-year-bond-yield): Spain 50Y government bond yield with long-term historical tracking

## Currency Exchange Rates & Forex

- [Nigerian Naira](https://tradingeconomics.com/nigeria/currency): Nigerian Naira (NGN) exchange rates vs USD, EUR, GBP with forecasts
- [Lao Kip](https://tradingeconomics.com/laos/currency): Lao Kip (LAK) forex rates vs USD, EUR, GBP with historical quotes
- [Seychelles Rupee](https://tradingeconomics.com/seychelles/currency): Seychelles Rupee (SCR) forex rates vs USD, EUR, GBP with forecasts
- [North Korea Currency](https://tradingeconomics.com/north-korea/currency): North Korea Won (KPW) exchange rate vs USD with forex data

## Stock Market Indices

- [Colombia Stock Market (IGBC)](https://tradingeconomics.com/colombia/stock-market): Colombia COLCAP/IGBC stock index with CFD quotes & market data
- [Vietnam Ho Chi Minh Stock Index](https://tradingeconomics.com/vietnam/stock-market): Vietnam VN Index (Ho Chi Minh) with HNX & historical market data
- [South Africa Stock Market (SAALL)](https://tradingeconomics.com/south-africa/stock-market): South Africa SAALL/JSE All Shares Index with market components
- [Warsaw Stock Exchange WIG Index](https://tradingeconomics.com/poland/stock-market): Poland WIG Index from Warsaw Stock Exchange with historical data

## Commodities & Energy Prices

- [Naphtha](https://tradingeconomics.com/commodity/naphtha): Naphtha commodity prices (USD/T) with CFD trading data & forecasts
- [Soda Ash](https://tradingeconomics.com/commodity/soda-ash): Soda Ash commodity prices in CNY/T with CFD trading benchmarks
- [Italy Electricity Price](https://tradingeconomics.com/italy/electricity-price): Italy electricity spot prices (EUR/MWh) with European market data
